description.default: One-click publish documents as SiYuan-rendered HTML folders to WebDAV, FTP, SFTP servers or a local folder (Linux/Windows), with a publish dashboard, change detection and re-publish.
description.zh_CN: 一键将文档以「HTML (SiYuan)」格式发布到 WebDAV / FTP / SFTP 服务器或本地目录（Linux/Windows），完整保留双链、块嵌入与图片资产；内置发布看板、改动检测与一键重新发布。
